input: Tasks Completed: Reviewed twelve case files for the regional desk and reconciled every entry against the archive ledger. Prepared a consolidated digest for the wing head covering the backlog, the pending field reports and the open requests. Coordinated with the operations section to schedule the archive scanner for the next fortnight. Drafted three analytical notes on recurring discrepancies in the district submissions.

Trained two new desk officers on the reporting template and checked their first submissions. Closed the long standing request from the provincial office after verifying the supporting documents.

Impact: Backlog down 20 percent

Challenges: Late field reports

Support Required: Scanner access

Tasks Planned: Monthly digest

Confidence Level: 4

Report Period: 2025-03-01 to 2025-03-07
